Usage Instructions

4.LTX2.3 cannot directly export videos in a 16:9 or 9:16 aspect ratio. A 1280×720 video will be output as 1280×704 after processing. To fix this, the workflow first resizes the video to 1280×736 via pre-processing nodes, then crops it back to 1280×720 after generation.

5.The workflow is set by default for 1280×720 and 720×1280 videos. To use other resolutions, adjust the maximum edge length and aspect ratio settings.

6.When removing subtitles or watermarks, start processing from frames before the subtitles/watermarks appear. Otherwise, they cannot be fully erased.

7.The subtitle and watermark removal mode comes with minor image enhancement effects. However, heavy motion in footage may cause facial distortion. This feature works best for relatively static scenes.
